_doc: Single source of truth for every Unreal data struct. C++ (Source/WalkTheArchive/Public/Data/WTATypes.h), the data converter (Pipeline/data/build_data.py -> WalkTheArchive/Data/*.json) and the editor setup (Content/Python/wta_setup/data_tables.py) must all match this file exactly. Field order = declaration order. Types: Name=FName, Text=FText, String=FString, Int=int32, Float=float, Bool=bool, Vector=FVector (cm, UE axes), Vector2D=FVector2D, Color=FLinearColor (linear, A=1), View=FWTAView, SoftTexture=TSoftObjectPtr<UTexture2D>, SoftClass=TSoftClassPtr<AActor>, SoftObject=FSoftObjectPath, Array<T>=TArray<T>. Bool fields keep the b prefix in C++ and JSON. JSON for a row: {"Name": <row id>, <Field>: <value>, ...}; Vector as {"X":..,"Y":..,"Z":..}; Vector2D as {"X":..,"Y":..}; Color as {"R":..,"G":..,"B":..,"A":1}; View as {"Location":{X,Y,Z},"Yaw":deg,"Pitch":deg,"bValid":true}; Soft refs as full object path strings ("/Game/WTA/Art/T_Art_ca_200.T_Art_ca_200") or "" when unset.

FWTAView.doc: A place to stand and look from. Location = the player's EYE position in cm (floor height + 162).

FWTABookBlock.doc: One block on a book page. Type is one of Para, List, Quote, Note, Code (FName).

FWTAExhibitRow.doc: 15 gallery exhibits + the Freedom to Read board + the 12 Wax Hall reenactment cards (bWax). Location = centre of the artwork; Yaw = direction the artwork faces; Size = artwork width x height in cm.

FWTARoomRow.doc: Room boxes in cm (UE axes). Wing groups rooms (museum, wax, lib, school, play).

FWTATourStopRow.doc: Row name = stop number zero-padded (S01..S35). ItemId points at DT_Exhibits for exhibit stops. Action: '' | OpenItem | OpenBook | OpenStation | OpenRide | GoPlace.

FWTAStaffRow.doc: Location = feet position in cm; Yaw = facing. MetaHuman is set once the MetaHuman Blueprint exists (/Game/WTA/Characters/<Id>/BP_<Id>.BP_<Id>_C).

FWTAStaffRuleRow.doc: Preset answers that are fixed text. Pattern is an ICU regex (case-insensitive) tested against the question. Order = priority (lower first). StaffOnly/StaffNot filter by staff id. Action: '' | GoPlace | OpenItem | OpenBook | StartTour | OpenBadges.

FWTATokenRow.doc: RideGate = ride id that must be running to collect it ('' = always).

FWTAWaxSceneRow.doc: StageLocation = front-centre of the stage floor; StageYaw = direction the stage faces (toward the aisle). Sequence = Level Sequence once authored ('' until then).

FWTAStationRow.doc: Hands-on stations (sieve, titration, pendulum, bench, diorama). Steps = step titles; Panel = the intro paragraphs shown in the station panel.
